style: Read the lines below as Nika, a warm, cheerful, natural American English female voice narrating short videos of a kids' learning app for parents on Instagram: friendly, gently upbeat, clear, smiling, never robotic, never shouting. Make a clear pause of about one second after every line. Read only the lines:
lines: Order up! Panda wants a burger. Your little chef grills the patty, flips it, stacks the bun and rings the bell. Pretend play like this teaches kids to follow steps, one at a time. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Who looks sad? Who looks happy? The friends show different feelings, and your child finds the right face. Naming feelings is a big skill for little kids. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Spin the wheel and find the letter! Balloons float by, and your child catches the right letters and drops them into the truck. When the truck is full, off it goes! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
All aboard the Shape Express! Stars, hearts, ovals and diamonds float by. Your child drops each one into the matching wagon, and the train chugs away. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Load each truck by color! Your little builder drops every block into the matching truck. Red with red, green with green. Colors, sorting and happy trucks! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Tiny hands, big concert! Every colorful key plays a happy note, so there's no wrong way to play. Little ones discover rhythm and sound. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.

One lemonade, coming right up! Fox is thirsty. Your little chef slices the lemon, squeezes the juice, adds ice and rings the bell. Serving a happy customer is the best part! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Which robot has more? Kids count the pictures and pick the answer. Counting practice that feels like play. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Can your kid find the matching pairs? Flip two cards and remember where each truck is hiding. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Puzzle time! Drag each piece into place and watch the smiley school bus appear. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Snip, snip, grow! Your child trims the tree, and soon shiny red apples appear. A calm, cozy game about nature and patience. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Here's a fun guessing game. Can your toddler match the animal to its shadow? Pause and play along! Every right answer gets a big cheer. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
Peekaboo! Little animals pop out of the boxes. Can your child tap them before they hide again? Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.

Pop, pop, pop! Zuzu calls out a color, and your little one pops only those balloons. It's great practice for listening and learning colors. Wrong balloon? No problem, just try again. Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.

Watch this house come to life! Little artists pick a color and tap to fill it in. No mess, no stress, just fun. And when the picture is done, the whole band throws a party! Pofu Kids, free on the App Store.
